mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_event_nurture_step_execution ( tenant_id, enrollment_id, sequence_id, step_id, step_order, action_type, status, skip_reason, external_ref, error_msg, create_time ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{enrollmentId}, #{sequenceId}, #{stepId}, #{stepOrder}, #{actionType}, #{status}, #{skipReason}, #{externalRef}, #{errorMsg}, COALESCE(#{createTime}, NOW()) )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crm_event_nurture_step_execution e JOIN crm_event_nurture_enrollment en ON en.id = e.enrollment_id WHERE en.wechat_mp_openid = #{openId} AND e.action_type = 'mp_template' AND e.status = 'sent' AND e.create_time >= #{since} AND e.external_ref LIKE CONCAT('preset:', #{presetId}, '%')
